continuation.description:
If the success response contains a continuation token, there are more links you can list. You can use this token as a query parameter and retrieve more links from the list, for example `/v1/designs/{designId}/analytics/links?continuation={continuation}`.

To retrieve all links, you might need to make multiple requests.

link_id.description: The ID of the trackable link.

name.description: The user-visible name of the trackable link.

total_view_count.description: The total number of views for this link.

unique_view_count.description: The number of unique viewers for this link.

total_view_duration_seconds.description: The total time this link has been viewed, in seconds.

average_view_duration_seconds.description: The average time this link has been viewed, in seconds.

last_viewed_at.description: When this link was most recently viewed, as a Unix timestamp (in seconds since the Unix Epoch).
